messages:
tayla-recruiter: Hey folks — need quick routing on an offer for Priya (SWE IC). Hiring manager Jordan wants an early start 2026-04-01. Proposed comp: base $165k, additional uplift to reach $175k via $10k sign-on. Band is S3. Request: approve start date, sign-on split, and benefits effective day 1 if possible. cc @anna-people-ops @ben-finance
anna-people-ops: Thanks Tayla. Quick clarifying Qs: is this a backfill or new headcount? any relocation/visa? Also is the $175k base or total comp? We need manager + finance, and comp committee if base is above band.
jordan-engineering: It's a backfill for Lucy, no visa, no relocation. Jordan here — manager ok on the numbers, prefer candidate start 4/1.
ben-finance: FYI finance check: band S3 max base $165,000. The proposed $165k base + $10k sign-on is within band cap on base, but total is +$10k vs midpoint. Payroll note: payroll cut for Apr cycle closes 2026-03-25. If we want benefits effective 4/1, HRIS record needs to be in by 2026-03-29 to meet enrollment cutoff.
tayla-recruiter: Candidate prefers full sign-on up-front but will accept split if needed. Proposing split: $6k on first paycheck, $4k at 90 days. Can benefits be effective day 1 if we get paperwork in?
comp-approvals-bot: Policy lookup: Band S3 base cap = $165,000. Any base > $165k triggers comp committee review. Sign-on and one-time bonuses do not trigger committee if structured as one-time payments. (ref: comp-policy#s3)
ben-finance: To avoid comp committee delay, finance recommends capping base at $165k and putting remaining dollars into sign-on/bonus. Approve sign-on split as long as cost center owner signs off (ENG-PLAT-02). Jordan confirmed cost center approval.
anna-people-ops: Routing plan: 1) Manager approval (done). 2) Finance approval for sign-on structure (ben ack). 3) People Ops conditional approval for benefits effective 4/1 contingent on HRIS record by 2026-03-29. 4) If base > $165k -> comp committee (we avoid by capping). Tayla please confirm wording so I can add conditional note to offer.
tayla-recruiter: Confirmed: offer will state base = $165,000, sign-on $10,000 split 6k/4k, start 2026-04-01. Benefits requested effective 2026-04-01 pending HRIS entry by 2026-03-29. Candidate accepted split verbally, will sign.
anna-people-ops: Sounds good. I'm adding a conditional approval note: "People Ops approves offer contingent on HRIS hire record timestamp <= 2026-03-29. If not met, benefits enroll will default to first of next month and sign-on timing unchanged."
ben-finance: Finance approves the capped base + split sign-on and start date. Recording cost impact to ENG-PLAT-02.
comp-approvals-bot: Recording: approval path complete (manager, finance, people ops conditional). No comp committee required.
tayla-recruiter: Thanks everyone — I'm sending the offer now. I'll update thread with signed offer timestamp and HRIS entry. :thumbsup:
